title: An Email to Mom and Dad
synopsis: Lili writes an email to her parents after arriving in the U.S.

fullText.simplified:
给爸爸妈妈的信

亲爱的爸爸妈妈：

    我已经到美国一个星期了。从北京坐飞机到西雅图要16个小时，这让我这几天很累，很想睡觉。我本来想给你们打电话，但是因为时差，所以我决定给你们写邮件。我在这里一切都很顺利，请不要担心。关于吃的东西，这里有很多中国饭店和中国超市，可以买到很多菜。
    我本来担心这里的中国菜跟中国的不太一样，我怕我会不喜欢这里的食物。因为来美国以前，我听说美国的中国菜，有的菜太咸了，有的菜太甜了。但是没想到，西雅图的中国菜和其他美国城市不一样。这里的中国菜非常好吃！
    关于交通，在这里坐车和在中国几乎一样方便，而且，公车上的人没有中国公车上的人多。关于城市的环境，这里有很多山，也有很多公园，所以我很喜欢。跟中国比，这里的天空非常蓝。
    星期一我去了学校，跟中国的大学很不一样。在这里，我的同学从很多不同国家来。我到了学校以后，有一个同学给了我一个很大的拥抱，欢迎我来美国。开始的时候，我觉得有些不好意思，因为在中国，不认识的人不会和同学拥抱。但是现在，我觉得很开心，因为我觉得同学们很友好。老师也告诉我们，如果遇到问题，那么我们可以问她。
    关于天气，这里的夏天没有北京那么热，所以我非常喜欢。虽然现在是夏天，天气很热，但是教室里很冷。跟中国比，这里的空调的温度比较低。哦，还有一个很有意思的事情，我发现我的同学喝茶的时候会放糖。我觉得真的太奇怪了。因为在中国，没有人会把糖放在茶里。
    爸爸妈妈，我很想你们，现在我也想给你们一个很大的拥抱。
    祝你们身体健康！爱你们的女儿：丽丽
fullText.traditional:
給爸爸媽媽的信

親愛的爸爸媽媽：

    我已經到美國一個星期了。從北京坐飛機到西雅圖要16個小時，這讓我這幾天很累，很想睡覺。我本來想給你們打電話，但是因為時差，所以我決定給你們寫郵件。我在這裡一切都很順利，請不要擔心。關於吃的東西，這裡有很多中國飯店和中國超市，可以買到很多菜。
    我本來擔心這裡的中國菜跟中國的不太一樣，我怕我會不喜歡這裡的食物。因為來美國以前，我聽說美國的中國菜，有的菜太鹹了，有的菜太甜了。但是沒想到，西雅圖的中國菜和其他美國城市不一樣。這裡的中國菜非常好吃！
    關於交通，在這裡坐車和在中國幾乎一樣方便，而且，公車上的人沒有中國公車上的人多。關於城市的環境，這裡有很多山，也有很多公園，所以我很喜歡。跟中國比，這裡的天空非常藍。
    星期一我去了學校，跟中國的大學很不一樣。在這裡，我的同學從很多不同國家來。我到了學校以後，有一個同學給了我一個很大的擁抱，歡迎我來美國。開始的時候，我覺得有些不好意思，因為在中國，不認識的人不會和同學擁抱。但是現在，我覺得很開心，因為我覺得同學們很友好。老師也告訴我們，如果遇到問題，那麼我們可以問她。
    關於天氣，這裡的夏天沒有北京那麼熱，所以我非常喜歡。雖然現在是夏天，天氣很熱，但是教室裡很冷。跟中國比，這裡的空調的溫度比較低。哦，還有一個很有意思的事情，我發現我的同學喝茶的時候會放糖。我覺得真的太奇怪了。因為在中國，沒有人會把糖放在茶裡。
    爸爸媽媽，我很想你們，現在我也想給你們一個很大的擁抱。
    祝你們身體健康！愛你們的女兒：麗麗

sentences.simplified: 我本来想给你们打电话，但是因为时差，所以我决定给你们写邮件。
sentences.traditional: 我本來想給你們打電話，但是因為時差，所以我決定給你們寫郵件。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ běn lái xiǎng gěi nǐ men dǎ diàn huà dàn shì yīn wèi shí chā suǒ yǐ wǒ jué dìng gěi nǐ men xiě yóu jiàn

sentences.simplified: 我在这里一切都很顺利，请不要担心。
sentences.traditional: 我在這裡一切都很順利，請不要擔心。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài zhè lǐ yí qiè dōu hěn shùn lì qǐng bú yào dān xīn
sentences.english: I was going to call you, but because of the time difference, I decided to write you an email.

sentences.simplified: 关于吃的东西，这里有很多中国饭店和中国超市，可以买到很多菜。
sentences.traditional: 關於吃的東西，這裡有很多中國飯店和中國超市，可以買到很多菜。
sentences.pinyin: guān yú chī de dōng xi zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhōng guó fàn diàn hé zhōng guó chāo shì kě yǐ mǎi dào hěn duō cài
sentences.english: Everything is going well for me here. Please don’t worry.
In terms of food, there are lots of Chinese restaurants and Chinese supermarkets here. I can buy lots of groceries.

sentences.simplified: 我本来担心这里的中国菜跟中国的不太一样，我怕我会不喜欢这里的食物。
sentences.traditional: 我本來擔心這裡的中國菜跟中國的不太一樣，我怕我會不喜歡這裡的食物。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ běn lái dān xīn zhè lǐ de zhōng guó cài gēn zhōng guó de bú tài yí yàng wǒ pà wǒ huì bù xǐ huan zhè lǐ de shí wù

sentences.simplified: 因为来美国以前，我听说美国的中国菜，有的菜太咸了，有的菜太甜了。
sentences.traditional: 因為來美國以前，我聽說美國的中國菜，有的菜太鹹了，有的菜太甜了。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi lái měi guó yǐ qián wǒ tīng shuō měi guó de zhōng guó cài yǒu de cài tài xián le yǒu de cài tài tián le
sentences.english: I was worried that the Chinese food here would be different from China. I was afraid that I wouldn’t like the food here.

sentences.simplified: 但是没想到，西雅图的中国菜和其他美国城市不一样。这里的中国菜非常好吃！
sentences.traditional: 但是沒想到，西雅圖的中國菜和其他美國城市不一樣。這裡的中國菜非常好吃！
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì méi xiǎng dào xī yǎ tú de zhōng guó cài hé qí tā měi guó chéng shì bù yí yàng zhè lǐ de zhōng guó cài fēi cháng hǎo chī
sentences.english: Because before I came to the U.S., I had heard that some Chinese food in America is too salty or too sweet.
But to my surprise, Chinese food in Seattle is not like other American cities. The Chinese food here is extremely tasty!

sentences.simplified: 关于交通，在这里坐车和在中国几乎一样方便，
sentences.traditional: 關於交通，在這裡坐車和在中國幾乎一樣方便，
sentences.pinyin: guān yú jiāo tōng zài zhè lǐ zuò chē hé zài zhōng guó jī hū yí yàng fāng biàn

sentences.simplified: 而且，公车上的人没有中国公车上的人多。
sentences.traditional: 而且，公車上的人沒有中國公車上的人多。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě gōng chē shang de rén méi yǒu zhōng guó gōng chē shang de rén duō
sentences.english: As for transport, taking a bus is almost as convenient as it is in China.

sentences.simplified: 关于城市的环境，这里有很多山，也有很多公园，所以我很喜欢。
sentences.traditional: 關於城市的環境，這裡有很多山，也有很多公園，所以我很喜歡。
sentences.pinyin: guān yú chéng shì de huán jìng zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō shān yě yǒu hěn duō gōng yuán suǒ yǐ wǒ hěn xǐ huan
sentences.english: Also, there are fewer people on the buses than the buses in China.

sentences.simplified: 跟中国比，这里的天空非常蓝。
sentences.traditional: 跟中國比，這裡的天空非常藍。
sentences.pinyin: gēn zhōng guó bǐ zhè lǐ de tiān kōng fēi cháng lán
sentences.english: As for the city’s environment, there are lots of mountains and lots of parks here, so I really like it.
Compared to China, the sky here is extremely blue.

sentences.simplified: 星期一我去了学校，跟中国的大学很不一样。
sentences.traditional: 星期一我去了學校，跟中國的大學很不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: xīng qī yī wǒ qù le xué xiào gēn zhōng guó de dà xué hěn bù yí yàng

sentences.simplified: 在这里，我的同学从很多不同国家来。
sentences.traditional: 在這裡，我的同學從很多不同國家來。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè lǐ wǒ de tóng xué cóng hěn duō bù tóng guó jiā lái
sentences.english: On Monday I went to school. It is very different from universities in China.

sentences.simplified: 我到了学校以后，有一个同学给了我一个很大的拥抱，欢迎我来美国。
sentences.traditional: 我到了學校以後，有一個同學給了我一個很大的擁抱，歡迎我來美國。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ dào le xué xiào yǐ hòu yǒu yí ge tóng xué gěi le wǒ yí ge hěn dà de yōng bào huān yíng wǒ lái měi guó
sentences.english: Here, my classmates come from lots of different countries.

sentences.simplified: 开始的时候，我觉得有些不好意思，因为在中国，不认识的人不会和同学拥抱。
sentences.traditional: 開始的時候，我覺得有些不好意思，因為在中國，不認識的人不會和同學擁抱。
sentences.pinyin: kāi shǐ de shí hou wǒ jué de yǒu xiē bù hǎo yì si yīn wèi zài zhōng guó bú rèn shi de rén bú huì hé tóng xué yōng bào
sentences.english: After I got to school, a classmate gave me a really big hug and welcomed me to America.

sentences.simplified: 但是现在，我觉得很开心，因为我觉得同学们很友好。
sentences.traditional: 但是現在，我覺得很開心，因為我覺得同學們很友好。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì xiàn zài wǒ jué de hěn kāi xīn yīn wèi wǒ jué de tóng xué men hěn yǒu hǎo
sentences.english: At first, I felt a bit embarrassed because people don’t hug classmates they don’t know in China.

sentences.simplified: 老师也告诉我们，如果遇到问题，那么我们可以问她。
sentences.traditional: 老師也告訴我們，如果遇到問題，那麼我們可以問她。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo shī yě gào su wǒ men rú guǒ yù dào wèn tí nà me wǒ men kě yǐ wèn tā
sentences.english: But now, I feel very happy because I feel like all my classmates are very friendly.
The teacher also told us that if we run into any problems, we can ask her.

sentences.simplified: 关于天气，这里的夏天没有北京那么热，所以我非常喜欢。
sentences.traditional: 關於天氣，這裡的夏天沒有北京那麼熱，所以我非常喜歡。
sentences.pinyin: guān yú tiān qì zhè lǐ de xià tiān méi yǒu běi jīng nà me rè suǒ yǐ wǒ fēi cháng xǐ huan

sentences.simplified: 虽然现在是夏天，天气很热，但是教室里很冷。
sentences.traditional: 雖然現在是夏天，天氣很熱，但是教室裡很冷。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán xiàn zài shì xià tiān tiān qì hěn rè dàn shì jiào shì lǐ hěn lěng
sentences.english: As for the weather, the summer here isn’t as hot as in Beijing, so I really like it.

sentences.simplified: 跟中国比，这里的空调的温度比较低。
sentences.traditional: 跟中國比，這裡的空調的溫度比較低。
sentences.pinyin: gēn zhōng guó bǐ zhè lǐ de kōng tiáo de wēn dù bǐ jiào dī
sentences.english: Although it’s currently summer, and the weather is very hot, inside the classroom it is very cool.

sentences.simplified: 哦，还有一个很有意思的事情，我发现我的同学喝茶的时候会放糖。
sentences.traditional: 哦，還有一個很有意思的事情，我發現我的同學喝茶的時候會放糖。
sentences.pinyin: ò hái yǒu yí ge hěn yǒu yì si de shì qing wǒ fā xiàn wǒ de tóng xué hē chá de shí hou huì fàng táng
sentences.english: Compared to China, the air conditioning is set to a lower temperature.

sentences.simplified: 我觉得真的太奇怪了。因为在中国，没有人会把糖放在茶里。
sentences.traditional: 我覺得真的太奇怪了。因為在中國，沒有人會把糖放在茶裡。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jué de zhēn de tài qí guài le yīn wèi zài zhōng guó méi yǒu rén huì bǎ táng fàng zài chá lǐ
sentences.english: Oh, there is another interesting thing. I discovered that when my classmates drink tea, they put sugar in it.
I find this really strange. Because in China, nobody puts sugar in tea.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸妈妈，我很想你们，现在我也想给你们一个很大的拥抱。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸媽媽，我很想你們，現在我也想給你們一個很大的擁抱。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba mā ma wǒ hěn xiǎng nǐ men xiàn zài wǒ yě xiǎng gěi nǐ men yí ge hěn dà de yōng bào

sentences.english: Mom and dad, I really miss you. Right now, I also want to give you a big hug.

sentences.simplified: 祝你们身体健康！
sentences.traditional: 祝你們身體健康！
sentences.pinyin: zhù nǐ men shēn tǐ jiàn kāng

sentences.simplified: 爱你们的女儿：丽丽
sentences.traditional: 愛你們的女兒：麗麗
sentences.pinyin: ài nǐ men de nǚ ér lì lì
sentences.english: Wishing you good health!

raw.synopsis: Lili writes an email to her parents after arriving in the U.S.
sentence_translations: An Email to Mom and Dad
Dear Mom and Dad,
It’s already been a week since I arrived in the U.S.
The flight from Beijing to Seattle took 16 hours, which made me really tired and sleepy these last few days.
I was going to call you, but because of the time difference, I decided to write you an email.
Everything is going well for me here. Please don’t worry.
In terms of food, there are lots of Chinese restaurants and Chinese supermarkets here. I can buy lots of groceries.
I was worried that the Chinese food here would be different from China. I was afraid that I wouldn’t like the food here.
Because before I came to the U.S., I had heard that some Chinese food in America is too salty or too sweet.
But to my surprise, Chinese food in Seattle is not like other American cities. The Chinese food here is extremely tasty!
As for transport, taking a bus is almost as convenient as it is in China.
Also, there are fewer people on the buses than the buses in China.
As for the city’s environment, there are lots of mountains and lots of parks here, so I really like it.
Compared to China, the sky here is extremely blue.
On Monday I went to school. It is very different from universities in China.
Here, my classmates come from lots of different countries.
After I got to school, a classmate gave me a really big hug and welcomed me to America.
At first, I felt a bit embarrassed because people don’t hug classmates they don’t know in China.
But now, I feel very happy because I feel like all my classmates are very friendly.
The teacher also told us that if we run into any problems, we can ask her.
As for the weather, the summer here isn’t as hot as in Beijing, so I really like it.
Although it’s currently summer, and the weather is very hot, inside the classroom it is very cool.
Compared to China, the air conditioning is set to a lower temperature.
Oh, there is another interesting thing. I discovered that when my classmates drink tea, they put sugar in it.
I find this really strange. Because in China, nobody puts sugar in tea.
Mom and dad, I really miss you. Right now, I also want to give you a big hug.
Wishing you good health!
Your daughter who loves you, Lili
